description: Source code defining the runtime interface functions for the AOTI (Ahead-Of-Time Inductor) component in PyTorch's TorchInductor. It provides function implementations for creating, deleting, running, and managing model containers and models, with exception handling macros and external C linkage.

classes.name: AOTINoGradGuard
